primarySource.citation: Paller, V. G. V., Corpuz, M. N. C., & Bandal, M. Z. Jr. (2017). Freshwater fish assemblages and water quality parameters in Seven Lakes of San Pablo, Laguna, Philippines. Asian Journal of Biodiversity, 8(1), 1-22. https://doi.org/10.7828/ajob.v8i1.995
sourceFactsReviewed: The publisher page describes a two-year ichthyofaunal survey of the seven named San Pablo lakes and reports ten fish species in aggregate.
The paper reports sampling from February 2013 through January 2014 and April 2014 through March 2015, with monthly wild-fish collection per lake by local fisherfolk.
The paper describes identification references but no per-specimen accession or voucher number was located in the reviewed source text.
The publisher-readable PDF contains the per-lake table, but no item-specific reuse license or rights grant for this 2017 article was found.
primarySource.access: Publisher page and PDF text reviewed through browser; no local raw copy retained.
primarySource.rightsDecision: Citation and limited facts about the study may be recorded. Do not copy or publish the species table until the article-specific license or permission is confirmed. The current submission policy does not establish the signed rights terms for this older item.

alternativeSource.citation: Guevarra, R. D., Paraso, M. G. V., & Lola, M. S. E. G. (2020). Biomarker Evaluation in Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) to Assess the Health Status of Aquaculture Areas in the Seven Lakes of San Pablo. Philippine Journal of Science, 149(3-a), 833-840. https://doi.org/10.56899/149.3A.11
sourceFactsReviewed: The indexed publisher abstract reports 84 cultured adult Nile tilapia samples, 12 per lake, for aquaculture-area health assessment.
This is cultured-fish biomarker evidence, not a wild-fish assemblage inventory or an equivalent alternative for the 2017 survey table.
No item-specific reuse license was verified; the journal's general author guide describes a copyright-transfer form for accepted manuscripts but does not establish rights in this particular article.
alternativeSource.access: Official publisher search-indexed abstract reviewed; direct page and PDF requests returned HTTP 403; no local raw copy retained.
alternativeSource.rightsDecision: No table or species-occurrence assertion is admitted from this source.

decision: Keep per-lake fish rows held for all seven lakes. The item-rights question remains open for the 2017 assemblage paper, and the 2020 alternative has the wrong evidence scope to replace it.
nextAction: Reopen only if the publisher or rights holder supplies item-specific reuse terms, or an independently suitable primary source with eligible rights is found. Continue the regional sequence without treating this held batch as a blocker.
